name: leaf
description: Generative UI: the agent builds the page the task needs, composing existing widgets or writing new ones, and a messaging and collaboration bus carries the user's comments and edits back into the session.

interface.longDescription: The agent builds the page the task needs from an open vocabulary of widgets: options to click for a decision, a board to drag for a triage, a live dashboard for a long run. A messaging and collaboration bus carries comments and edits back into the session.
defaultPrompt: Present this work as a Leaf page.
Use Leaf to put this plan on a page.
